sources.title: Ravnica
sources.author: Wizards of the Coast
sources.relevant_summary: Official plane overview stating that Ravnica has ten two-color guilds and that the dragon-led blue-red Izzet fuse elemental magic and technology as masters of innovation.

sources.title: Planeswalker's Guide to Return to Ravnica: Part 2
sources.author: Magic Creative Team
sources.relevant_summary: Primary official worldbuilding source for Izzet identity, mandate, Niv-Mizzet, internal court, key locations, roles, weirds, Interlocus, and attitudes toward other guilds.

sources.title: A Flavorful Guide to the Guilds of Ravnica
sources.author: Wizards of the Coast
sources.relevant_summary: Official Guilds of Ravnica feature summarizing Izzet values, invention, civic engineering, Niv-Mizzet's leadership, Ral Zarek's day-to-day role, and Ral's hidden Bolas allegiance at that story point.

sources.title: Guilds of Ravnica Mechanics
sources.author: Matt Tabak
sources.relevant_summary: Official mechanics article for Guilds of Ravnica identifying Izzet among featured guilds and explaining jump-start as a Guilds of Ravnica mechanic.

sources.title: Return to Ravnica Mechanics
sources.author: Wizards of the Coast
sources.relevant_summary: Official mechanics article describing Return to Ravnica guilds, calling Izzet blue-red experimenters, and explaining overload as the Izzet League mechanic.

sources.title: Getting Kitted Out with Guilds Kits
sources.author: Wizards of the Coast
sources.relevant_summary: Official guild kit article stating that Izzet is all about spells and connecting replicate, overload, and jump-start across Ravnica visits.

sources.title: Commanding the Guilds of Ravnica
sources.author: Wizards of the Coast
sources.relevant_summary: Official Commander-focused article describing Izzet as blue-red, tied to public works, infrastructure, experimentation, instants, sorceries, combinations, and mana mastery.

sources.title: Rules
sources.author: Wizards of the Coast
sources.relevant_summary: Official rules landing page identifying the Comprehensive Rules as the reference document for Magic rules and linking DOCX, PDF, and TXT versions.

sources.title: Magic: The Gathering Comprehensive Rules
sources.author: Wizards of the Coast
sources.relevant_summary: Current Comprehensive Rules text reviewed for the rules meaning of replicate, overload, and jump-start.

sources.title: Planeswalker's Guide to Murders at Karlov Manor
sources.author: Wizards of the Coast
sources.relevant_summary: Official current-status Ravnica guide describing the post-Phyrexian invasion state of the guilds, Niv-Mizzet as current Living Guildpact, Izzet reconstruction work, and some Izzet/Simic being drawn to Phyrexian opportunities.

sources.title: The Legends (and Characters) of Murders at Karlov Manor
sources.author: Wizards of the Coast
sources.relevant_summary: Official character feature identifying Niv-Mizzet, Guildpact as the current embodiment of the Living Guildpact and the most intelligent being on Ravnica.

sources.title: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
sources.author: Wizards of the Coast
sources.relevant_summary: Official story source for Operation Desperation: Ral explains the plan to resurrect Niv-Mizzet as the new Living Guildpact and for Niv-Mizzet to step down as Izzet guildmaster.

sources.title: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Rallying the Reluctant
sources.author: Wizards of the Coast
sources.relevant_summary: Official story source showing the Izzet League led by Master Zarek and Chamberlain Maree during the War of the Spark crisis and referencing the dead Firemind before Operation Desperation.

sources.title: Project Lightning Bug
sources.author: Doug Beyer
sources.relevant_summary: Official story source identifying Ral Zarek as an Izzet guildmage and secret Planeswalker, and showing Jace Beleren as Living Guildpact at that story point.

sources.title: March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same
sources.author: Wizards of the Coast
sources.relevant_summary: Official story source during the Phyrexian invasion referring to Ral Zarek as Izzet guildmaster.

sources.title: polarkac/MTG-Stories
